description: Set the bookmarks (outline) of a PDF. Existing bookmarks are replaced. Nest with children. For signed PDFs, preserveSignatures: true sets them while keeping the signatures intact. When the input declares PDF/UA-2, each bookmark goes to a structure destination as ISO 14289-2 §8.8 requires: a GoTo action whose SD names the structure element that starts on the target page, with D kept as the page destination for viewers that do not read SD. A page with no structure content gets a page destination and is named in warnings (v0.27.0).

open.description: Whether children start expanded. Default true.

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

bookmarks.description: Array of bookmarks, each { title, page, open?, children? }. page is 1-based. Nest via children — up to 8 levels and 2000 entries in total.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the target PDF.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

preserveSignatures.description: Edit a signed PDF via an incremental update (appending) without invalidating existing signatures. Default false. The original bytes are untouched, so /ByteRange holds. Changes beyond the certification (DocMDP) permission level are refused.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

name: add_bookmarks
title: Add Bookmarks (Outline)
